<a id="introduction"></a>

:::note

Several test elements use JMeter properties to control their behaviour. These properties are normally resolved when the class is loaded. This generally occurs before the test plan starts, so it's not possible to change the settings by using the [`__setProperty()`](../functions.md#__setProperty) function.

:::
